faqs.q: What is the difference between 3-tab and architectural shingles on a Montclair home?

runs.v: Architectural shingles bond multiple layers of fiberglass mat into a dimensional profile that lasts 30 years, per the InterNACHI life-expectancy chart, and carries a higher ASTM D3161 wind class than the single-layer 3-tab, which lasts 20 years and rates near 60 mph at Class A. Class F sits near 110 mph, and many architectural lines warranty higher under 6-nail installation, per ARMA and manufacturer guidance.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit for an asphalt shingle re-roof in Montclair?
